details.code_configuration_warning: Atomic_libero still points to data_split_json/output_report_test.json, which is absent from this tree; checked actual published libero_lerobot.json.
details.annotation_identity: Candidate default TFDS deterministic interleave 16 files x 16 records and converter suite order; all 80 inspected records match both task text and all_frames exactly; no original source hashes in annotation JSON.

annotation_pipeline.input: One complete episode per LeRobot Parquet: image/actions/state/task_index; meta/tasks.jsonl
annotation_pipeline.segmentation: Gripper action changes, filtered change points, and EEF translation/rotation windows determine coarse intervals; task-specific heuristics and merging apply.
annotation_pipeline.semantic_assignment: The model generates a full-clip Task Chain. analyze_action_segment3 parses that chain and assigns steps positionally; it does not invoke model.chat per segment. Preset task overrides and fallback cases exist; export filters non-positional assignments.
annotation_pipeline.output: train_annotations.json, report.json, excluded.json, failed.json; resume and dry-run supported
annotation_pipeline.endpoint_code: Coarse final end=total_len; adjacent starts=previous end+1; export accepts end<=source_frames; video slicing range(start,end) is exclusive.
annotation_pipeline.validation: Read-only source inspection; no model execution or exact reproduction claim.
